name: Hip 1357
sale: Fasig-Tipton October Yearlings 2026 — consigned by Gainesway, Agent II
notes: Chestnut filly. Olympiad (Speightstown) won the Jockey Club Gold Cup (G1) and was 2nd in the Breeders' Cup Classic, $3M+ earned. She is from his second crop (conceived at a $35,000 fee); his 2026 fee dropped to $20,000, a mild caution, but his first 2-year-olds have sold well ($300K, $300K, $230K) and he has a stakes winner in Citrus Springs ($466,170), no graded winner yet. Dam Marmo Moon (Malibu Moon) was placed at 2 and 3 and this is her first foal. 2nd dam Rebalite has 5 winners including G2 winner and sire Race Day; 3rd dam Printing Press produced Kentucky Oaks and Santa Anita Oaks winner Lite Light plus several sires. Mr. Prospector appears on both sides around the 4th generation (Gone West / Macoumba), normal for American speed. Bought for $10,000 and owned 100%, far below what the sire's stock has been bringing, so the Market score is maxed.
